collection.name: isolationSystems
collection.doc: 🛞 Seismic isolation system of a bridge deck (EN 1998-2 chapter 7) or of a building (EN 1998-1 chapter 10): the bilinear hysteresis of the isolator units added up (characteristic strength Q_d, post-yield stiffness K_d, yield displacement d_y) and their displacement capacity d_max; the checks find the effective stiffness K_eff, the effective period T_eff, the equivalent damping ξ_eff and the design displacement d_cd.

fields.name: bridge_id
fields.doc: 🌉 Id of the bridge whose deck rests on the isolation system (EN 1998-2 chapter 7); empty for an isolated building.

fields.name: building_id
fields.doc: 🏢 Id of the building whose base rests on the isolation system (EN 1998-1 chapter 10); empty for an isolated bridge.

fields.name: strength_n
fields.doc: 🔩 Sum over the isolator units of the characteristic strength Q_d [N]: the force at zero displacement of the bilinear hysteresis loop (yield force minus K_d d_y).

fields.name: stiffness_n_per_m
fields.doc: 〰️ Sum over the isolator units of the post-yield stiffness K_d [N/m] of the bilinear hysteresis loop.

fields.name: yield_displacement_m
fields.doc: ↔️ Yield displacement d_y [m] of the bilinear hysteresis loop (elastic stiffness K_1 = K_d + Q_d/d_y).

fields.name: capacity_m
fields.doc: 📏 Displacement capacity d_max [m] of the isolator units; the design displacement d_cd must not exceed it.
